cāyasmato.l: tathā pahīno cāyasmato Mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosī
cāyasmato.g: therassa kira imaṁ bojjhaṅgabhāvanaṁ sādhukaṁ suṇantassa etadahosi “mayhaṁ pabbajitadivasato sattame divase saccāni paṭivijjhantassa ime bojjhaṅgā pātubhūtā”ti.
